eligibility_rationale: Manual nectar robbing is the experimental interaction state that changes pollinator behaviour and seed production; it is not an independently declared plant trait coordinate with pollinator and antagonist functions responding to A.

Aphid herbivory causes floral morphology/reward changes and downstream pollination/reproductive effects. The antagonist is an upstream causal treatment, not a second receiver response to the resulting floral coordinate.

Herbivore identity and plant ontogenetic stage are experimentally varied and change flowering traits, pollinator visitation, pollen-beetle colonization and seed fitness. No one floral trait axis is isolated with two matched functional response surfaces.
